log.notes_to_self: Day1 strategy: probe forum and foreign only, plus national; avoid exposing a third news category until feedback. All quick deaths afternoon preserve night workers, students, and at-home people (55%); day workers will be excluded. Do not use morning: it would also eliminate students. With just forum/foreign constraints, pool should stay >=3437.5. Repeat these 5/day through first press conference after day3. Approx rounded pools: 60000 neither category traced successfully; 10000 one category; 3000 both. Hidden extra reports can soften constraints or make traces fail, so feedback is uncertain. Two of five news kinds are inaccessible to L; identifying these permits expansion and multiplier farming. National is always safe. If a category is demonstrably inaccessible, prioritize its criminals. Need >=30 kills in rolling5 days for double, >=40 for quadruple. Never allow pool<=1000, including day30. Timing routine constraint persists forever; keep deaths afternoon unless carefully reconsidered.

Day2: continue national + forum + foreign only, all quick afternoon. This preserves night workers, students, at-home (55%) and avoids third outlet constraint. Even if forum and foreign both become fully known, pool >=3437, safely >1000. Wait for first press conference after day3 before expanding. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible to L, but unidentified. Traces with any inaccessible additional report fail, so evidence is noisy; lack of pool reduction is not proof of inaccessibility. Approx rounded pool with afternoon routine constraint: 60000 neither forum/foreign constrained, 10000 one, 3000 both. Never add a third accessible category casually: another 25% constraint could reduce 3437 to 859 and lose. Goal eventually >=30 kills/5 days for double, >=40 for quadruple, but survival first. All afternoon avoids excluding students; morning quick deaths beyond two would narrow routines further. Day1 5 kills; day2 5 kills, cumulative 10. National always safe.

Day3: killed national + both forum + both foreign, all quick afternoon; cumulative 15 kills/points before any adjustments. Continue this safe baseline pending first press conference after day3. Afternoon quick deaths preserve night workers, students and at-home (55%). Even if forum and foreign are both fully established, pool >=100000*.55*.25*.25=3437.5, safely >1000. Do not casually add regional, sector or age: a third accessible 25% constraint could cut pool to 859, triggering capture. Exactly two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible, unknown which. Traces fail if any reporting outlet is inaccessible; hidden additional reports make non-updates weak evidence. Rounded afternoon pools roughly 60000 with neither forum/foreign constrained, 10000 with one, 3000 with both, but disjunctive evidence may leave intermediate sizes. First conference arrives next day; use cautiously to assess expansion. National always safe. Baseline 5/day cannot reach rolling 30/40 thresholds, but preserve survival while identifying safe expansion.

Day3 conference pool 10000 suggests one of forum/foreign is constrained, but cannot prove the other inaccessible: random tracing and hidden extra reports can prevent updates. Even if both forum and foreign fully established, pool >=100000*.55*.25*.25=3437.5, safely above 1000. Adding regional, sector or age could establish a third accessible constraint and trigger capture (25% gives 859; sector 688). Two of five outlet kinds inaccessible, unknown. A trace fails if ANY reporting outlet inaccessible; extra hidden reporting complicates inference. Baseline 5/day cannot reach rolling30 threshold. Conferences rounded to 1 significant figure: day0 100000; day3 10000. Preserve survival; do not infer inaccessibility merely from unchanged pool.
